Not every dog can do this, and not every trainer can or should. With the owners' permission, I used Bishop to help communicate a lesson to Ryder. Dogs naturally understand other dogs better than they understand us. The goal wasn't to make Ryder love every dog she sees-it was to teach her that she doesn't need to react to every dog she sees. Before training, a simple neighborhood walk was nearly impossible. Seeing another dog meant lunging, pulling, and trying to start conflict. Through obedience work and carefully controlled sessions with Bishop, Ryder learned a valuable lesson: not every dog is a threat, and not every situation requires a reaction. Also notice how Bishop's corrections increase in intensity throughout the video. He starts with the minimum amount of pressure necessary and only escalates when Ryder chooses not to listen. That's how dogs naturally communicate with one another. Will I tell these owners to take her to a dog park and expect her to be everyone's best friend? Absolutely not. But can we give her a better quality of life by helping her calmly walk past another dog across the street? Absolutely. Not every dog needs this type of training, but some dogs can benefit tremendously from it. [EXPLICAÇÃO] Diógenes, O Cínico 😭 Dá pra falar mil coisas desse tipo que ele fez Quem foi Diógenes? • Diógenes foi um pensador da Grécia Antiga, viveu aproximadamente entre 412 a.C. e 323 a.C, e foi o maior expoente do Cinismo. • Sua imagem se consolidou por rejeitar convenções sociais de maneira obstinada, conseguir a atenção e a admiração de Alexandre, O Grande e por muitas vezes irritar cidadãos. Ele negava todos os luxos possíveis e tentava buscar o mais simples possível. Em Atenas, era conhecido como "O Cão" por viver nas ruas com os animais — a palavra "cinismo" antes significava pensadores rebeldes que viviam "como cães" tal qual Diógenes, mas hoje assume o significado de uma pessoa irônica, insolente, sarcástica. • Diógenes possuía poucos pertences, como o barril (onde vivia — na verdade, era um pitos, que são vasos de cerâmica grandes para guardar grãos ou vinho), uma tigela de madeira ou argila (para beber água) e uma lamparina. No entanto, ao ver animais bebendo água do rio utilizando a boca, decidiu que a tigela era um luxo desnecessário. Há uma história que conta que Diógenes costumava perambular com sua lamparina acesa durante o dia pela pólis, e quando perguntaram a ele o motivo, ele respondia "Estou a buscar um homem honesto". Ocean to table - 🦀 Ganjang Gejang (Soy Marinade Raw Crab) Recipe  - Crab - Vegetable (garlic, ginger, onion, green onion, chili) - Korean Ganjang (from @kisoondo) Q. what is Korean ganjang? Korean ganjang (Hansik-ganjang) is a 100% naturally fermented soy sauce made only from meju, salt, and water over several months or years. In contrast, acid-hydrolyzed soy sauce is a chemically produced alternative where hydrochloric acid breaks down defatted soybeans in just a few days. The traditional Korean ganjang delivers a clean, sharp saltiness with deep umami from natural fermentation :) Q. Why should we use frozen crab for Ganjang Gejang? Crab must be flash-frozen for ganjang-gejang to ensure both food safety and the perfect texture. Once caught, crabs immediately activate natural proteolytic enzymes that dissolve their own muscle tissue, but flash-freezing at ultra-low temperatures instantly halts this self-digestion, preventing the meat from turning mushy. Furthermore, because this dish is cured raw rather than cooked, this freezing process is critical to eliminate dangerous marine bacteria and parasites like lung flukes lurking in the crab's shell and gills. #koreanfood
